defect: The same adjustment was listed up to six times in a row, reading as a debug transcript.
fix: A recurring trigger and response is grouped into one line carrying its count and period span; at most four lines show before an explicit expand; applied and declined stay separate.
timingIntegrity: The adjustment index is mapped through the authoritative possession ledger to a period, an Early/Mid/Late phase and the score at that moment. No raw possession index and no fabricated clock is shown.
namedCoaches: Coach <surname>, with particles preserved (Coach Van Gundy, not Coach Gundy).
example: Coach Van Gundy re-hid the weak defender twice between Q3 and Q4 as the hidden defender kept getting dragged into the action.
